The '''Llanic Spice Run''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] run located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The route traveled through the [[Thuris sector/Legends|Thuris sector]] and the [[Torch Nebula/Legends|Torch Nebula]] before reaching its terminus at the appropriately named [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Spice Terminus/Legends|Spice Terminus]] in [[Parmic sector/Legends|Parmic sector]].

During the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] this route was constantly patrolled by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Abran Balfour/Legends|Abran Balfour's]] [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Group]].<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>
